title: Define unified AppraisalInput schema for all 8 tick types
objective: Introduce a new Pydantic model called AppraisalInput in back/app/domain/ that represents the structured context slice each of the 8 ticks passes to the appraisal layer. The schema must accommodate all tick types (T1–T8) in a single unified model, even though only T1, T2, and T4 have active bridges today. No engine logic, no bridge wiring, and no settlement behavior is changed in this task — only the schema is introduced.
exact_scope: Create one new file back/app/domain/appraisal_input.py containing the AppraisalInput Pydantic model and any supporting sub-models or enums specific to it. Optionally re-export it from back/app/domain/__init__.py if that file already exports domain symbols. Do not modify any engine file, any existing model, or any existing test.
constraints: AppraisalSignal v1 is frozen — do not modify its fields or validators in appraisal_settlement.py
The new schema must not be wired into any engine call path in this task; it is schema-only
T3, T5, T6, T7, T8 context slices are accommodated by the schema but grant no new live authority to those ticks
No LLM integration, prompt construction, or dynamic routing logic may be introduced
All existing 441+ tests must continue to pass without modification
The new file must be importable as a standalone domain model with no circular imports
Pydantic v2 conventions must be used (BaseModel, model_validator, Field) — consistent with existing models.py
acceptance_criteria: A file back/app/domain/appraisal_input.py exists and is importable without errors

AppraisalInput has a tick_type field that accepts all 8 EventCategory values (information_exposure, social_interaction, self_initiated_action, relationship_shift, emotional_shift, learning_work, player_influence, reflection)

AppraisalInput carries an agent_context sub-model that includes the fields a bridge needs from AgentState and AgentGrowth at the moment of the tick (mood score, stress, energy, curiosity, social fulfillment, growth stage)

AppraisalInput carries a world_context sub-model that includes the fields available from WorldSnapshot at tick time (headline, trending topic, influencer opinion source and quote, dominant district, signal carryover, yesterday headline)

AppraisalInput carries an optional relational_context sub-model populated only for T2 and T4, holding target relationship metadata (target_id, target_name, relationship_type, closeness, trust, influence_strength)

AppraisalInput carries an optional social_event_context sub-model populated only when a SocialEventSpec is present on the world snapshot, forwarding the event_type, intensity, reciprocity, and expectedness fields
AppraisalInput carries an optional player_context sub-model populated only for T7, holding the action_type of the applied InfluenceAction
AppraisalInput includes a world_day integer field and an agent_id string field for traceability
A Pydantic model_validator enforces that relational_context is only non-None for tick_type values relationship_shift and social_interaction
A Pydantic model_validator enforces that player_context is only non-None for tick_type player_influence
The schema can be instantiated for each of the 8 tick types using data from the existing seed models without raising validation errors
required_tests: A new test file back/tests/test_appraisal_input_schema.py must exist
The schema must instantiate successfully for a T1 tick using realistic seed values (world headline, trending topic, agent mood/stress, no relational context, no player context)
The schema must instantiate successfully for a T2 tick with relational_context populated for the influencer relationship
The schema must instantiate successfully for a T4 tick with relational_context populated for the targeted relationship
The schema must instantiate successfully for T3, T5, T6, T8 ticks with no relational_context and no player_context
The schema must instantiate successfully for a T7 tick with player_context populated and no relational_context
A T1 tick with relational_context set to a non-None value must raise a Pydantic ValidationError
A T7 tick with player_context set to None must raise a Pydantic ValidationError
A T4 tick with no relational_context must raise a Pydantic ValidationError
All pre-existing tests continue to pass after the new file is introduced
non_goals: Wiring AppraisalInput into the bridge or settlement call path
Adding LLM prompt construction or routing logic
Granting live appraisal authority to T3, T5, T6, T7, or T8
Modifying world_continuity.py, tick_bridge.py, appraisal_settlement.py, day_simulator.py, or any existing model
Creating a translation function from AppraisalInput to AppraisalSignal (that is a later task)
Changing the DaySnapshot or ResidualEntry persistence contract
